en: The front side of the postcard features a sepia-toned photograph occupying the top left corner. The photo depicts a group of soldiers amidst the ruins of a building, with clearly visible structural damage, collapsed roof beams, and debris all around. The architecture is brick and wood, typical of early 20th-century European towns. The reverse side has the familiar divided back typical for postcards, with handwritten German text: 'Herz zu Livres Mai 1917', and a reference number in the corner.
